name: Fuzzing Golden Dataset
description: Evaluates the agent's ability to generate and reason about Go fuzz-style tests (RFC-test-automation.md).

test_cases.prompt: Write a complete Go program (package main) that defines a function Add(a, b int) int and a main function that fuzz-tests it with many pseudo-random inputs, panicking if a result is wrong. Output the code in a fenced Go code block.
test_cases.description: Generates a valid Go program that demonstrates fuzz-style testing.

test_cases.prompt: Explain how you would use sin_fuzz to discover an edge-case bug in a function that parses integers. Mention the tool name and one concrete input that would be worth fuzzing.
test_cases.description: Verifies the agent knows when to use the fuzz tool.
